newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Costello says housing downturn at an end.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Costello says housing downturn at an end.

text.p: Australian treasurer Peter Costello said he believed the downturn in the Australian housing sector has bottomed and there should be a pick-up in 1997.
"We now think that (housing supply outstripping demand) has now bottomed," Costello said in an address to a business luncheon.
"There are some signs that the housing industry... is going to start kicking back in in 1997."

The housing sector, which is one of the key components of the Australian economy, has been in the doldrums for the last two financial years. Companies exposed to this sector have suffered large profit slumps and employment has dropped.
